name: Cancer Descending (Corky Borgman), LDRS 26, Jean Dry Lake

measured.data: barometric altimeters: Transolve 6400 ft and Olsen 5975 ft, averaged

notes: the swept fin's tip trailing edge (sweep 16 + tip chord 5.5 = 21.5 in) is 2.5 in behind the root trailing edge (19 in) and the file puts it 0.5 in behind the base; the 3D mesher takes a fin outline that reaches behind the root trailing edge by at most half the root's distance to the base, so the fin is moved 3 in forward (te_to_base 5.05 in instead of 2.0): same fin, different station
source: RASAero II Comparisons with Altitude Data, https://www.rasaero.com/comparisons-alt.htm (C. E. Rogers); geometry, weights, motor and site from the example file shipped with the free RASAero II download, https://www.rasaero.com/dl_software_ii.htm (RASAero_II_Setup_Version_1.0.2.0.zip, Examples/CancerDescending.CDX1)
